verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a Personnel object with custom fields and user access reviews in which reviewers can revoke access and generate follow-up tasks that sync to ticketing tools. That is only adjacent support for proving leavers lost access. Nothing documents HR-synced onboarding or offboarding checklists or training-completion tracking. Missing for 10: HR/HRIS integration driving personnel lifecycle, onboarding checklists, security-awareness training tracking, offboarding-triggered access removal evidence, independent corroboration.
